info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Status Retrieval API enables partners to access the current status of retail orders efficiently. By querying the status endpoint, users can retrieve updates on the progress of their orders, facilitating timely decision-making and customer communications. Typical consumers include retail managers, customer service representatives, and e-commerce platforms seeking to enhance user experience through order tracking. This API supports businesses in maintaining transparency with customers regarding their purchase journey.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their orders. It provides updates on processing, shipped, or delivered statuses, enabling users to track their orders effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is for retrieving the status of orders. The payload must specify the relevant details required to fetch the order status.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of orders.

ListRetailOrdersStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for fetching the status of orders. It is expected to be a string value, typically containing a JSON object as a string.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.title: Order Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the order status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for tracking the order.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the order status.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.description: Response schema for the order status retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the order was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information related to the order.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken, in milliseconds, to process the request. Useful for performance monitoring.
